case: At least 25% of excluded worlds remain uncertain about the true top goal after one document, at every setting.
construction: Makers are nested within worlds. Reader comparisons share observations within a setting. Different setting cells use independent worlds; no paired causal claim. All unavailable outputs remain explicit.
controls: Inherited exact-law known answers plus Friday-specific alias, persistence, source and setting checks. Controls never impose a desired science effect.
interpretation: Exploratory constructed-method hierarchy endpoint map; miniature, architecture untested; no confirmation or human inference.
precision: 32 independent worlds per cell; maximum binomial Monte Carlo standard error 0.0884; log-score uncertainty estimated across worlds.
probe_rule: One excluded world at every declared setting; complete original, replay and scalar reconstruction. Per-pass cost uses the largest observed whole-world time with 50% margin, plus overhead.
question: At 10 top goals and 20 pieces, does the short-versus-long episode contrast retain the sign pattern observed at 12 pieces under partial and heavy overlap?
registration_reason: The six-cell 64-world H1-X09 study was held before admission because its measured reservation exceeded the then-available H1 ceiling. After H1-X10 exposed a sign change between episode endpoints at 12 pieces, this new card prospectively tests the 20-piece endpoint with four cells and 32 worlds per cell. It is a lower-precision exploratory map, not a retry or confirmation.
routes: Sounding Line T3/T5: own-library mismatch and records needed at the hierarchy top.
